newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent weaker but trading within a range.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent weaker but trading within a range.

text.p: Brent crude oil futures in Asia were lower late on Monday following the fall in London on Friday, brokers said.
October Brent on SIMEX traded at $18.85 per barrel at 0840 GMT, down 14 after London closed seven cents lower at $18.99, due to short term profit taking.
But brokers remained positive, seeing a downtrend only if prices broke the $18.42-support level.
Prices were instead expected to trade within the range of $18.42 to $19.48 this week.
November Brent was quoted at $18.90/$19.03, down from Friday's $19.12 close in London.
NYMEX crudes on ACCESS last traded at $19.91, down 16 cents per barrel from New York's $20.07 close.
